qa_highlights.question: How did pipe demand look in July and August, and what is the outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said pipe demand degrew in Q1 across pipe companies, picked up from August, and is expected to stay good through December as PVC prices stabilised and turned upward.

qa_highlights.question: What were Oleo sales in Q1 FY27 and can the segment reach INR 55-60 crore by year-end?
qa_highlights.answer: Q1 Oleo revenue was about INR 5.3 crore. Management said it is 'very positive' on the year-end target; the analyst's INR 55-60 crore figure was not confirmed, and the INR 65-70 crore FY27 target was given later in the call.

qa_highlights.question: When will CPVC margins recover toward 20-22%?
qa_highlights.answer: CPVC margin is about 18% now and management targets 20-21% by Q4 FY27. Recovery depends on demand, since supply currently exceeds demand, and on local raw material sourcing, which is adding cost.

qa_highlights.question: Volume, price and mix split, new customers, and stabilizer versus specialty volume growth?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to share product volume data and suggested the analyst connect offline.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the EBITDA margin is structural versus temporary?
qa_highlights.answer: Lower sales-related expenses, since the company skipped exhibitions in Q1, and lower ECL provisions offset the drop in contribution margin, leaving EBITDA margin impact negligible. Lead-free PVC offtake was lower, which hurt mix.

qa_highlights.question: What is the utilisation of the existing stabilizer capacity and the threshold to sustain margins?
qa_highlights.answer: The expanded plant was fully operational only from 21 May 2026, so utilisation is expected to be around 30-35% in Q2 and Q3 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Were there one-off items in other income or forex in Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: A forex gain of about INR 1 crore was reflected in other income.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY27 revenue growth guidance of 30-40% still maintained, and how much Egypt revenue is included?
qa_highlights.answer: Management reaffirmed 30-40% growth for FY27 and said the company is already on track, though demand was weak due to the war. Egypt is only partly included: FY27 Egypt estimate is cut to INR 30-35 crore from INR 50-60 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Oleo revenue potential over 2-3 years?
qa_highlights.answer: FY27 Oleo target is INR 65-70 crore and the three-year target is INR 150-200 crore.

qa_highlights.question: Impact of Lubrizol and Aditya Birla CPVC resin capacity on Platinum?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the resin capacity is complementary, since additives are about 25% of a CPVC compound and resin about 75%. The company has supplied Supreme and Prince Pipes for 1-2 years, and the transition will take time.

qa_highlights.question: Competitive intensity and pricing pressure in lead-free and CPVC?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is no direct CPVC additive competition in India apart from one other Indian company. In lead-free, Baerlocher and Reagens are the main competitors, Goldstab is mainly lead-based, and pricing levels are understood by all players.

qa_highlights.question: Margin outlook versus the roughly 23% margins of FY23-FY24?
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed the change to a mix shift from high-margin lead-free to lower-margin CPVC, which started at a 3-7% contribution margin. Guidance is PAT margin of 11-12% and EBITDA margin of 13-15%, reiterated from the previous call.

qa_highlights.question: Project-wise capex, timelines and revenue potential for Egypt and Palghar?
qa_highlights.answer: Egypt is expected by December 2026, with INR 250-300 crore top line over three years. Palghar peak potential is INR 700-800 crore over three years, and top-line CAGR is about 35% over three years.

qa_highlights.question: What bottlenecks could delay commissioning?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it does not expect much delay.

qa_highlights.question: Status of the stearates plant and its effect on revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: The 6,000 tpa stearates plant has slipped to September/October 2026 from August due to a delay in one equipment item. Management said it would not materially affect FY27 revenue growth.

qa_highlights.question: Status of Rivadu Lifesciences pharma and the outlook?
qa_highlights.answer: Business model is still being defined. Some revenue started this quarter, with collaborations with overseas companies under negotiation. No figure was given.

qa_highlights.question: Raw material inflation pass-through and contractual mechanisms?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it can pass on raw material price rises in normal conditions, but in the current war and shipping environment it cannot pass on sudden freight, CFS and transport costs. Lower lead-free PVC offtake was cited as the main Q1 margin driver.

qa_highlights.question: Egypt versus Palghar capex and why revenue potential differs?
qa_highlights.answer: Capex is about INR 67 crore for Egypt and INR 71 crore for Palghar. Both have about 60,000 tpa capacity, but Egypt is mainly lead stabilisers, priced at INR 110-150 per kg versus INR 250-300 for CPVC and INR 170-220 for calcium zinc in India.

qa_highlights.question: Incremental working capital needed for Egypt?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects roughly a three-month working capital cycle.

qa_highlights.question: Expected margins in Oleo chemicals in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Margins are expected to rise after the company builds its own manufacturing facility; for now it is using CDMO for seed marketing.

Target payback 3-4 years and ROCE in mid-20s on new capex, per management.
capex_capacity: Installed capacity at West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh facilities close to 70,000 tpa; combined capacity to exceed 115,000 tpa after Dahej phases are on stream.
Dahej greenfield (Gujarat): about INR100 crores investment, civil work advanced, equipment installation underway; commissioning around November 2026.
Naidupeta brownfield: about 5,000 tpa added, expected Q3 FY27. Capex amount not disclosed; to be shared offline.
Q1 FY27 capex and remaining FY27 capex not disclosed on call; management said it would follow up offline.
Naidupeta solar Phase 1 operational; R&D centre at Naidupeta inaugurated.
Proposed UAE subsidiary (BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO) to source raw materials and handle global distribution; not yet incorporated.
demand_pricing: ATMA data cited: Q1 FY27 vehicle volume growth of up to 26.6% for passenger vehicles, 16.5% two-wheelers, 16.5% commercial vehicles and over 11% three-wheelers.
Tire industry capex of about INR25,000 crores announced; about 25% of Indian tire output exported.
Management expects zinc-linked realisations to stay higher ('new normal') as commodity prices have risen; says company is neutral to zinc price levels.

Raw material: zinc dross supply disrupted by geopolitical conflict, but company maintained uninterrupted supply; management said crisis favoured established suppliers and shifted some customers toward JGC.
Around 90% of new sales expected to be direct to customers rather than through distributors.
Dahej customer mix guided at about 60% tire and 40% other segments.

qa_highlights.question: How much of EBITDA came from inventory gains and how much is reversible?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said margin came from operating leverage, higher-priced and specialised orders, and only a small inventory gain; amount not quantified. Margins of 10-12% are structural, with upside from value-added products.

qa_highlights.question: Will Dahej commission early or late in Q3?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said around November 2026.

qa_highlights.question: Will realisations sustain?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said higher realisations are the new normal given higher commodity prices, and he sees no near-term reversal.

qa_highlights.question: Why was the FY28 Dahej utilisation guidance lowered from 65-70% to 50-60%, and the margin guidance raised from 13-14% to 14-15%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the cut is conservatism because the plant start moved from H1 to Q3 FY27; it still sees close to 60%. The margin rise reflects new products and higher-realisation product launches.

qa_highlights.question: What are the payback and ROCE targets?
qa_highlights.answer: Payback of 3-4 years targeted, implying about 20-25% annual returns; ROCE expected in the mid-20s.

qa_highlights.question: What is the volume growth outlook and split between zinc oxide and zinc sulphate?
qa_highlights.answer: Mid-teens volume growth in the current quarter. The 15,000-17,000 tpa Dahej Phase 1 is all zinc oxide. Zinc sulphate is less than 5-6% of sales.

qa_highlights.question: Will the new products (LabPure, ZRA) carry higher margins and what is their market size?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said these are niche, higher-margin products for non-tire customers, slow to ramp; no market size or margin figures given.

risks_watch: Dahej Phase 1 commissioning slipped from H1 FY27 to around November 2026 (Q3 FY27); track whether it lands on that timeline and the ramp to 50-60% utilisation in FY28.
Margin quality: management said part of Q1 EBITDA came from a small inventory gain it would not quantify; Q2 margin profile said to be similar, so watch for reversal if zinc prices stop rising.
Realisations assumed to be the 'new normal' with no near-term reversal expected; a fall in zinc or commodity prices would test this view.
Capex disclosure gaps: Q1 FY27 capex, remaining FY27 capex and Naidupeta debottlenecking capex were not given on the call and were promised offline.

JG TUR recycled rubber commercial launch hoped for within about 12 months, with capex, capacity and revenue still undisclosed; new products LabPure and JG-ZRA are niche and slow to ramp with no market size given.
Raw material dependence on zinc dross, with supply disrupted by geopolitical conflict; uninterrupted supply so far, but a continued disruption could affect volumes.

544138|2026-06.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on demand, margins and the Dahej ramp, repeatedly citing structural tailwinds. Cautious and evasive on specifics: inventory-gain size, capex figures and the TUR project economics were deferred or left unquantified, and the Dahej start date was given only as 'sometime in November'.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Consolidated EBITDA margin 11.5% in Q1 FY27 vs 10.64% a year ago, with management now targeting 14-15% (from 13-14%) and Q2 margin profile guided similar, though part of Q1 came from an unquantified inventory gain.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.when: Q3 FY27 (Dahej ~Nov 2026); Naidupeta 5k tpa Q3 FY27
rows.why: Dahej Phase 1 of 15,000-17,000 tpa (~INR100 cr) is under construction with civil work advanced and equipment installation underway, and Naidupeta 5,000 tpa debottlenecking is set for Q3 FY27; installed capacity ~70,000 tpa rising to over 115,000 tpa after Dahej phases.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Volume growth was in double digits in Q1 and management guided mid-teens for the current quarter, with utilisation in the early 80s (~82%).

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Utilisation of ~82% with Dahej not online until Nov 2026 and Phase 2 expansion planned for around FY29; Q1 and remaining FY27 capex and Naidupeta capex were deferred offline, so a formal disclosure is pending.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management raised the long-term EBITDA margin target to 14-15% and guided higher Q2 sales, but cut Dahej FY28 utilisation to 50-60% for conservatism, so headline upgrades are conditional on the ramp.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Dahej already slipped from H1 FY27 to around November 2026; any further delay or a fade in the inventory-gain-aided Q1 margin would test the guidance.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: JG TUR recycled rubber commercial launch is hoped within ~12 months after successful pilot trials, and LabPure and JG-ZRA were introduced this quarter, though no market size or capex was given.

rows.label: Zinc sulphate push into Western India from Dahej by-product feed
rows.why: Zinc sulphate is under 5-6% of FY26 sales with Southern India as the core market, and Western expansion is planned using Dahej by-product raw material, but no timeline or size was given.

rows.label: UAE subsidiary (BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO)
rows.why: Proposed to source raw materials and handle global distribution, not yet incorporated; exports are 10-15% of sales today, guided ~15% in FY28-29.
